groups.R_reason: Clear yes/no based on Meta's official rollout of paid, ad-free tiers in the Philippines.

groups.T_reason: Fixed deadline of December 31, 2026.
groups.U_reason: Highly uncertain; while Meta has introduced paid tiers in the EU due to regulatory pressure, their viability in emerging markets like PH with lower purchasing power is heavily debated.

BDLT.T_reason: Ongoing quarterly Meta earnings calls and product announcements will keep the market active.

groups.yes_buyer: A digital marketer or privacy advocate who thinks Meta will roll out the ad-free tier globally to appease privacy-conscious users and diversify revenue.
groups.no_buyer: A local social media manager who thinks PH's low average revenue per user (ARPU) makes a paid tier commercially non-viable for the local market.
groups.tradeability_reason: The intersection of global tech corporate strategy and local market purchasing power creates a great trading environment.
groups.why_users_bet: Filipinos are incredibly protective of their free access to social media; any threat of monetization gets immediate attention.

groups.name: CAB Lowers Fuel Surcharge
groups.name_zh: 民航署调降航空燃油附加费
groups.narrative: The Civil Aeronautics Board lowers the passenger fuel surcharge to Level 13, promising cheaper local and international airfares.
groups.narrative_zh: 菲律宾民用航空署将客运燃油附加费标准下调至13级，预计将使六月国内及国际航班票价有所降低。
groups.R_reason: CAB fuel surcharge levels are adjusted on a strict, public, numerical scale.
groups.S_reason: Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) official website or official announcements in major news outlets like PNA.
groups.T_reason: Resolves when CAB issues the advisories for July 2026 (usually in mid-to-late June).
groups.U_reason: Tied to volatile global jet fuel prices, creating highly authentic market fluctuation.
groups.H_reason: Directly impacts ticket prices, of great interest to millions of travelers, OFWs, and travel agencies.

BDLT.B_reason: Strong interest from frequent flyers, OFWs returning for vacations, and travel agency owners.
BDLT.D_reason: Varying predictions on global crude oil trajectories and forex rates create solid, ongoing debate.
BDLT.L_reason: Specific to the Philippine regulatory framework for air travel.
BDLT.T_reason: Short, structured resolution window.

groups.yes_buyer: Frequent travelers and travel agents tracking international oil price drops who expect CAB to pass down the savings immediately.
groups.no_buyer: Aviation sector analysts and risk managers who anticipate oil price stability or recovery keeping the surcharge at Level 13 or higher.
groups.tradeability_reason: Clear numerical benchmarks and high financial relevance to the consumer travel sector ensure healthy trading volumes.
groups.why_users_bet: Allows frequent flyers and travel operators to hedge against shifting airfare costs for upcoming summer/monsoon travels.
